title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim-History Factor on First Claim Decisions
content:
On a first decision on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the deductible charged on the decision is multiplied by the decision's claim-history factor, which depends on the plan's paid claims — claims whose handling status is paid — with a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date.

## Schedule

| Paid claims on the plan with a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date | Claim-history factor |
| --- | --- |
| three or more | 1.75 |
| exactly two | 1.5 |
| exactly one | 1.25 |
| none | 1 |

## Notes

1. Only claims of this plan count, and only those whose handling status is paid; a claim approved but not yet paid, or denied, is not a paid claim.
2. The window is measured on each claim's loss date, back 36 whole months from the handling date.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A plan with paid claims whose loss dates fell 8 and 30 months before the handling date, and a third paid claim whose loss date fell 40 months before, has two paid claims in the window: the factor is 1.5, and a deductible of 200.00 becomes 300.00.
